items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 12:108:1
items.html: And then, at the time of birth, the blood returns to ascend, etc., that the lights of her NHY ascend upward until opposite the chest, etc., and become milk: As stated above in the adjacent item, that at the time of birth, when phase one returns there, by reason of the ascent of the bottom Hey to the Einayim, and the GAR [first three] departed from Tevuna — it is found then that the lights of HGT rose to the vessels of HBD, and the lights of NHY rose to the vessels of HGT. See there. Thus the lights of NHY, which are the discernment of the posterior of the Eheyeh, numerically equal to blood, which is the discernment of judgment, now became, there, in the place of HGT, milk, which is the discernment of mercy.
